data: For Apple's fiscal year 2023, which ended September 30, 2023, net sales were $383.3 billion ($383,285 million), down about 2.8% from $394.3 billion in fiscal 2022. Net income was $97.0 billion ($96,995 million), down about 2.8% from $99.8 billion the prior year, which works out to diluted earnings per share of $6.13. Total assets at the end of fiscal 2023 were $352.6 billion ($352,583 million), essentially unchanged from $352.8 billion at the end of fiscal 2022. These figures come from Apple's fiscal 2023 Form 10-K, filed November 3, 2023.
